title: Claude's Coding Dominance: The Real Story for Builders
caption:
Everyone spent months debating AI coding tools. Business Insider just reported the outcome: Claude already won the startup coding wars. This isn't about benchmarks; it's about what actually ships.

For builders, the shift has been quiet but decisive. Cursor, once the darling, is fading. Its core value proposition—an AI-native IDE—struggled against the flexibility and raw model performance of Claude-integrated workflows. The unglamorous part? Most developers want AI assistance *within* their existing setup, not a whole new environment.

Claude's superior context window and RAG capabilities simply enabled more effective, agentic approaches to complex coding tasks. What this does not do is eliminate the need for skilled engineering. But it clarifies which tools amplify that skill most effectively. If you're building, understanding this practical delta helps you operationalize your AI investments by Friday.

I break down one of these shifts every morning—one email, free, no fluff. Link in bio.
